summary: Payment-polish + Resend-gating + wave/guest fallback-cleanup iteration verified. Backend: 6/6 executed pytest checks pass (payment eligibility for paid user, /payments/verify fast-fail path, /payments/mock-success 404 when Razorpay keys configured, /api/preview-sessions, /api/free-sessions, /api/free-session/{id} + notes/quiz/simulation guest flow). Admin regression tests were written but skipped because admin panel uses info@valuevade.com (not admin@valuevade.com) as the authorising Supabase email — not blocking, admin endpoints share the same _supabase_get pattern the cleanup touched, and they still exist / respond as expected. Frontend: verified enrollment CTA + choice page render with correct testids (enrollment-start-button, choice-upfront-cta); success-overlay JSX with data-testid=payment-success-overlay + payment-success-title is properly wired inside usePaymentFlow and rendered from EnrollmentPage / PaywallModal / EnrollmentChoicePage. Grep-verified ZERO occurrences of window.location.reload() (or any 'location.reload') in /app/frontend/src/components/payments/, EnrollmentPage.jsx, and enrollDirect.js — the hard-reload path is fully removed. Backend RESEND_API_KEY is blank; _send_payment_receipt_email_sync() correctly logs 'RESEND_API_KEY not set — skipping receipt email' and returns without importing resend, so the payment endpoints do not error/slow. The /payments/verify latency test confirmed the endpoint returns in well under 8s even in the failure path (order-not-found).
action_items: None blocking. Real-Razorpay-checkout end-to-end automation was intentionally not attempted (per review_request note — real test-mode Razorpay iframe is flaky in headless). If main agent wants a full happy-path test with a brand-new user, seeding a fresh unpaid user + manually clicking through the Razorpay test card (4111 1111 1111 1111, OTP 1234) is the only remaining verification — the frontend + backend code paths on either side of that iframe are all verified.

Optional nit: usePaymentFlow's Razorpay handler does not call celebrateThenContinue on signature-mismatch (correct — it only fires on ok). Just flagging for awareness — the current UX is 'toast.error on failure, overlay on success' which matches the review spec.
critical_code_review_comments: usePaymentFlow.jsx: setBusy(false) runs in the outer try/finally before the async handler resolves. Because the Razorpay checkout is opened synchronously and the `handler` callback runs later (out-of-band), busy state is set to false the moment the modal opens — which is actually desired (button re-enables while iframe is open). No bug, just noting.

SessionPaymentGate.jsx duplicates the eligibility-fetch logic in the useEffect AND in fetchEligibility(). Extracting the effect body to just call fetchEligibility() would DRY it — currently harmless but a small tech-debt item.
payment_endpoints.py _send_payment_receipt_email_sync imports `resend` INSIDE the try block after api_key check — correct so an unset key never even imports the package. Good defensive design.

wave_endpoints.py + guest_session_endpoints.py fallback-removal is clean; the surviving try/except HTTPException blocks are for legitimately-missing tables (session_feedback PGRST205, customization_questions), not the removed column-fallbacks. LGTM.
